headline: Santiago Hazim es trasladado al tribunal, otros dos imputados no
summary: Santiago Hazim, former director of Senasa and the main defendant in an alleged fraud of nearly RD$16,000 million against the health insurer, was taken to a hearing that was later cancelled. Two other defendants did not appear.
why: Senasa is the Dominican Republic's national health insurance agency, which manages public health funds, so large alleged losses from it affect public finances and governance.
